Plan:
1. Read the active sheet’s cached values and collect all Budget IDs that have at least one Technology revenue line.
2. For each data row, write “Y” if its Budget ID is in that set, “N” if it has no linked Budget ID, and leave the cell empty otherwise.
3. Save the workbook with plain values in Q2:Q11.

```python
import shutil
import openpyxl

shutil.copy(INIT, OUT)

vals = openpyxl.load_workbook(INIT, data_only=True)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT)

ws = wb.active
vws = vals[ws.title]

tech_budget_ids = set()

for r in range(2, vws.max_row + 1):
    budget_id = vws.cell(row=r, column=10).value  # J: Budget ID
    budget_type = vws.cell(row=r, column=12).value  # L: Budget Type

    if budget_id is not None and str(budget_type).strip().lower() == "technology":
        tech_budget_ids.add(budget_id)

for r in range(2, 12):
    budget_id = vws.cell(row=r, column=10).value  # J: Budget ID

    if budget_id is None:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=17).value = "N"
    elif budget_id in tech_budget_ids:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=17).value = "Y"
    else:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=17).value = None

print("tech_budget_ids:", tech_budget_ids)
print("Q2:Q11:", [ws.cell(row=r, column=17).value for r in range(2, 12)])

wb.save(OUT)
```
